chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“The intentional act of a child and his mistake are one and the same.”

key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: a minor child who has not reached legal maturity
key_terms.وَاحِدٌ: treated as one and the same in legal effect

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a child’s intentional and mistaken acts in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle regarding the acts of a child, treating deliberate and mistaken conduct alike in legal liability. It is significant in jurisprudential discussions on responsibility, compensation, and rulings related to minors.
